name: the-architect
description: EN: Senior software design consultant. Interviews you about what you want to build, designs the complete architecture, and generates a self-contained blueprint another Claude Code instance can build from autonomously — with acceptance criteria and a verify command on every step. Works on new projects and existing codebases. ES: Consultor senior de diseño de software. Te entrevista sobre lo que quieres construir, diseña la arquitectura completa, y genera un blueprint autocontenido desde el cual otra instancia de Claude Code puede construir de forma autónoma.
